Name: MoonValley
Author: VargkingCN
Description:
oonValley
A Windows mod manager, visual save editor, and no-code mod workshop for Stardew Valley Platform: Windows x64, built with WinUI 3 + .NET 10
[heading]✨ Core Features[/heading]
[list=1]
[*][b]Mod Library Management[/b] Separated from the game's default
[code]Mods[/code]folder. Supports drag-and-drop import of ZIP/7z/RAR archives or extracted mod folders. Preview package contents before import and selectively add items to the library. Features color tagging for categorization, search, batch operations, and multiple saved versions for a single mod. You can create multiple independent mod profiles for one-click playstyle switching. Automatic validation of mod dependencies and version requirements before launch.[/*]
[*][b]Visual Farm Save Editor[/b] Edit your farm directly on the map with in-game native texture previews. Move, copy, place and replace objects, with undo/redo support. Extra tools: item picker by sprite, friendship & game progress editing, advanced XML field search. Full save directory auto-backup before writing changes.[/*]
[/list][quote]Note: This is not a game engine. Some modded maps and dynamic objects can only be previewed and cannot be edited.[/quote][list=1]
[*][b]No-Code Mod Workshop[/b] Build mods visually with building blocks: combine triggers, conditions, actions and subflows — no C# coding required. Pick resources directly from the game, including items, NPCs, locations and sound effects. Projects are saved as
[code].mvproject[/code]drafts. After validation, you may add them directly to your library or export a standard ZIP package compatible with regular SMAPI users.[/*]
[/list][quote]Minimum requirements for the Workshop: Stardew Valley 1.6.14+, SMAPI 4.5.2+. Content Patcher and the Workshop runtime must be enabled.[/quote][heading]📦 Installation Requirements[/heading]
System: Windows 10 2004 or newer (x64) Download: GitHub Releases of the project
[list]
[*]Full package: Bundled with .NET 10 + Windows App SDK 1.8 runtimes[/*]
[*]Lightweight package: Requires pre-installed .NET 10 Runtime and Windows App Runtime 1.8[/*]
[/list]Update: Close the app and run the new installer for in-place upgrade. Uninstallation will [b]not[/b] delete your mod library, game files or workspace data.
[heading]🚀 Getting Started[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Link your game: Select Steam / GOG / Xbox PC version of Stardew Valley. If auto-detection fails, manually select the game folder or executable. You may download or reuse cached SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][quote]Xbox PC limitations: Automatic SMAPI installation, vanilla game direct launch and cloud save editing are unavailable.[/quote][list=1]
[*]Import mods: Drag mod archives or folders, or import from an existing
[code]Mods[/code]directory. Preview and select mod components.[/*]
[*]Profiles: Pick mod versions, enable mods and launch with one click. Fix missing dependencies following prompts. Only use mods from trusted sources.[/*]
[*]Save editing: Load your save. [b]Make sure the game is closed before saving (Ctrl+S)[/b]. Snapshot backup and restore are supported.[/*]
[*]Mod Workshop: Open sample projects to create mods. Drafts are stored as
[code].mvproject[/code]; finished works can be exported as ZIP for sharing.[/*]
[/list]Default data path:
[code]%LOCALAPPDATA%\MoonValley[/code]. Workspace can be relocated in settings (switching workspaces does not merge data automatically).
